title: A FAULT THAT KEEPS REPEATING RELOADS THE GAME INTO THE TITLE WITH A SHORT NOTE
why: His answer (Tech): a crash reloads into the title with a note. One error never kills the frame loop, so the trigger is the same fault repeating every frame for 5 seconds. The run report keeps the crash, the last good save is not overwritten, the page reloads and the title says restarted after an error, then fades. One error, a short burst, a hidden page and the test pages never reload.
now: If the same error repeats for 5 seconds the game restarts into the title and says restarted after an error.

edits.anchor: // v14.49: and a new entry saves at most once a second, so a burst of different errors cannot save every frame either.
edits.replacement:
if(crashLoopSeen(kind,msg,where,now)){ crashRestart(); return; }   // v28.xx (cw-crashreload): the same fault for 5 s: no more saves, reload into the title
    // v14.49: and a new entry saves at most once a second, so a burst of different errors cannot save every frame either.
